title: Stylish Condo Escape with Balcony and Elevator
description:
Jolene on Main 205

The space
Experience the vibrant city of Nashville, TN, from the comfort of this stylish condo located just minutes away from top attractions. With the Johnny Cash Museum, Ryman Auditorium, and Country Music Hall of Fame all within a few miles, you'll be immersed in the heart of Music City. 

This modern condo features a king bed, queen bed, and all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay, including a TV, washer/dryer, and a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, fridge, oven, and more. Relax on the balcony with a cup of coffee from the provided coffee maker, or enjoy the central AC on warmer days. 

Conveniently located on a single level with an elevator in the building, this condo is family-friendly and offers a smoke detector for added safety. Whether you're exploring the nearby Bicentennial Capitol Mall State Park or enjoying a round of golf at Two Rivers Golf Course, this condo is the perfect home base for your Nashville adventures. 

Book your stay now and make unforgettable memories in Nashville at this cozy condo!

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
